pattern: a full test run goes through $T3CODE_GUARD when it is set
experience: With load management on, agents ran whole test suites bare; on a stressed machine nothing stopped them and the machine stalled.
rule: If $T3CODE_GUARD is set, run heavy builds and test suites as "$T3CODE_GUARD" -- <command>.
